description.en: Palaeoniscum freieslebeni has an elongate diamond-scaled trunk and a strongly asymmetric tail with a longer upper axis. Body breadth, missing fin edges and colour are inferred from compressed fossils; scale rows are simplified rather than exact counts.
description.zh: Palaeoniscum freieslebeni 具有修长的菱形鳞片躯干，以及上部轴线较长的明显不对称尾鳍。体宽、缺失鳍缘与颜色由受压化石推断；鳞列经过简化，并非精确计数。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original Palaeoniscum freieslebeni living stylization guided by photographed Gasser collection fossils, not a scan or exact specimen replica.

scientific_limits.en: Fossils are compressed, bent and incomplete. Three-dimensional breadth, complete fin edges, missing head details, posture and living color are inferred. The 0.20 m length is an artistic representative estimate, not a measurement of the photographed specimens. Scale rows are simplified geometry, not exact counts.
scientific_limits.zh: 化石有压扁、弯曲及缺失。三维宽度、完整鳍缘、缺失头部细节、姿态与活体颜色为推断。0.20米体长是艺术性代表估值，不是照片标本的实测值。鳞列采用简化几何，不声称精确数量。

frozen_scientific_scope.taxon_scope: Palaeoniscum freieslebeni; historical Palaeoniscus/Paleoniscus spellings treated as same candidate
shape_requirements: Preserve original elongate diamond-scaled trunk and sharply asymmetric tail.
Make continuous oblique rhomboid scale bands visible as low relief on the elongated flank, not a smooth generic fish.
Heterocercal caudal fin has a longer scaled upper axis and shorter lower lobe; do not use a symmetric modern fork.
Keep head taper and a distinct posterior dorsal fin, paired pectoral and pelvic fins and anal fin; complete outlines are conservative inference where fossils incomplete.
construction_notes: Use merged low-relief scale strips within budget, not hundreds of separate primitive objects.
Do not copy fossil bending or slab silhouette as living anatomy. Maintain natural straight swimming pose.
Subdued gray olive body and pale ventral region are artistic; no color evidence claim.

shape_gate.en: Shape criterion: elongate diamond-scaled trunk and sharply asymmetric tail. Retain this anatomical combination when compared with nearby forms; a name, scale or pose change alone does not qualify.
shape_gate.zh: 形态判据：长菱形鳞躯干与明显不对称尾。须与相近形态对照保留这一结构组合；仅改名称、尺寸或姿态不成立。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly brief: block elongate diamond-scaled trunk and sharply asymmetric tail with a small number of readable masses; preserve negative spaces and joint transitions. Use a restrained neutral palette; simplify surface texture only after the silhouette reads. Validate the diagnostic feature before detailed geometry.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形说明：用少量清晰体块组织长菱形鳞躯干与明显不对称尾；保留负空间与关节过渡。采用克制的中性色；轮廓成立后再简化表面纹理。精细几何制作前须核实鉴别特征。

frozen_scientific_scope.material_profile: palette-only static original geometry; restrained natural palette; no reference images embedded
frozen_scientific_scope.gray_model_gate: Three low-cost front/side/oblique checks before detailing; original inventory shape combination must read. No extra views except a specific unresolved problem.
frozen_scientific_scope.final_evidence: Four exact-export front/side/top/perspective views; perspective may equal preview. Existing technical/export/viewer gates, two isolated rebuilds and fresh independent QA remain required.
